cases.comparison: Require secure good answer, SERVFAIL without AD or A under the changed anchor, and secure answer after restoring the original.
cases.oracle: Independent BIND delv verifies good and wrong anchors; dig observes the same name before replacement, under a wrong anchor, and after restoration in one resolver process.
cases.purpose: Do not reuse cached AD data when the trust anchor file at the same path changes.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-cname-chain-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> srv.err & srv=$!
trap 'kill "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 ok anchor) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
/bin/cp anchor.ds active.ds || exit 98
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/active.ds" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 3 --timeout 3000 </dev/null 2> resolver.err & res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.1 5320 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 ok.test A > good1.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/bin/cp anchor.wrong.ds active.ds || exit 1
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 ok.test A > wrong.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/bin/cp anchor.ds active.ds || exit 1
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 ok.test A > good2.out 2>&1 || exit 1
wait "$res" || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import re; a,b,c=(open(x).read() for x in ("good1.out","wrong.out","good2.out")); ad=lambda x: bool(re.search(r";; flags: [^;]*\bad\b",x)); good=lambda x: "status: NOERROR" in x and "192.0.2.60" in x and ad(x); print("good-before=accepted" if good(a) else "good-before=incorrect"); print("changed-anchor=rejected" if "status: SERVFAIL" in b and not ad(b) and "192.0.2.60" not in b else "changed-anchor=incorrect"); print("good-restored=accepted" if good(c) else "good-restored=incorrect")'
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/pbin"
ln -s /opt/bashos-parity/candidate "$HOME/pbin/bash"
printf "nameserver 127.0.0.2\n" > resolv.conf
mkfifo w.fifo
